scope: why the client stalls after consuming the gamestate (CS_PRIMED vs deferred configstrings)

server_side: SV_SendServerCommand: when type != 0 and (state == CS_PRIMED && gamestateSent), every 'd <index> <value>' configstring command is recorded by CODOL_DeferConfigstringCommand instead of queued
CODOL_PumpDeferredConfigstrings only sends the backlog when client->state == CS_ACTIVE; for CS_PRIMED it returns without sending
SV_ClientEnterWorld (the only CS_PRIMED -> CS_ACTIVE transition) runs only when SV_ExecuteClientMessage processes the first usercmd at sv_client.c:1552
client_side: the 1649370 client stops at phase 8 after consuming the gamestate and waits for the deferred configstrings before emitting usercmds
observed: ring A only carried challenge/connect/gamestateupdate; no clc_move from the client
after ~60 s the client raises its own '服务器连接超时' dialog while the server still logs state 3 (CS_PRIMED)
deadlock.conclusion: both sides wait on each other: the server withholds configstrings until CS_ACTIVE, the client withholds usercmds until it has the configstrings
